item.title: RKS, Lelean and Grammar field teams in every grade
item.description: Navitalai Naivalurua · 06/08/2026 Three schools competing in the Vodafone Fiji Secondary Schools Rugby Union Super Deans Competition will field teams in every grade this year.
item.content:encoded:
Navitalai Naivalurua · 06/08/2026

Three schools competing in the Vodafone Fiji Secondary Schools Rugby Union Super Deans Competition will field teams in every grade this year.

They are Ratu Kadavulevu School, Lelean Memorial School and Suva Grammar School.

RKS are the defending Super Deans champions after defeating Nasinu Secondary School 53-15 in last year's final, while Lelean enter the national playoffs as the top qualifiers from the Eastern Zone.

Suva Grammar are the top team from the Southern Zone after successfully defending their title with a 29-22 win over Nasinu earlier this year.

The national quarterfinals will be played across four venues this weekend – Suva, Tavua, Vatukoula and Savusavu.

In the Under-18 quarter-finals, Lelean will face Ratu Navula College at 4.30pm, followed by Suva Grammar against Ba Provincial Free Bird Institute at 5.55pm, with both matches at the HFC Bank Stadium.

At Garvey Park in Tavua, Ra will take on RKS at 1.40pm, while Cuvu College will face Nasinu Secondary School at 3.05pm.

item.title: Bower to start in All Blacks Greatest Rivalry tour opener
item.description: Navitalai Naivalurua · 06/08/2026 George Bower has been named to start for the All Blacks in the opening match of their Greatest Rivalry tour of South Africa, taking on the Stormers this Saturday.
item.content:encoded:
Navitalai Naivalurua · 06/08/2026

George Bower has been named to start for the All Blacks in the opening match of their Greatest Rivalry tour of South Africa, taking on the Stormers this Saturday.

Bower will start at prop alongside Samisoni Taukei'aho and Pasilio Tosi in the front row.

Prop Siale Lauaki and inside back Josh Jacomb are in line to make their All Blacks debuts, while Patrick Tuipulotu will captain the side in the tour opener.

The All Blacks face the Stormers at 5am this Saturday.

They then take on the Sharks next Wednesday at 5am , the Bulls on August 16th at 5am, and the Lions on August 26th at 5am.

The first Test against South Africa will be played on August 23rd at 3am. The second Test follows on August 30th at 3am, the third on September 6th at 3am, and the fourth and final Test on September 13th at 3am.

item.title: Ba puts domestic rivalry aside to back Rewa's OFC Champions League campaign
item.description: With Rewa FC set to fly Fiji's flag in the OFC Men's Champions League from this Sunday, Ba Football Association President Praneel Dayal is urging football fans to put club rivalries aside and unite behind the Delta Tigers as they chase Oceania's biggest club title. Dayal extends his best wishes to Rewa FC President Nazeel Buksh, the club's management, coaching staff and players, acknowledging the
item.content:encoded:
With Rewa FC set to fly Fiji's flag in the OFC Men's Champions League from this Sunday, Ba Football Association President Praneel Dayal is urging football fans to put club rivalries aside and unite behind the Delta Tigers as they chase Oceania's biggest club title.

Dayal extends his best wishes to Rewa FC President Nazeel Buksh, the club's management, coaching staff and players, acknowledging the commitment and hard work required to build a team capable of competing against Oceania's best.

He says reaching the OFC Men's Champions League was a significant achievement that reflected the vision, dedication and leadership shown by the club's administration.

Dayal also notes that while Rewa will play its opening pool match in Lautoka, Ba will proudly host the club for the remaining group stage matches and looked forward to welcoming the team and supporters.

He calls on Ba FC supporters to set aside traditional domestic rivalries during the tournament and get behind Rewa as Fiji's sole representative, saying the team would be carrying the hopes of the nation.

Dayal encourages fans to fill the stands, give Rewa a warm welcome and showcase Fiji's passion for football to the rest of Oceania.

He also wishes the team success in its campaign and expressed hope that Rewa would make the country proud by bringing the OFC Men's Champions League title home.

Meanwhile, Rewa FC will take on Vanuatu's Galaxy FC at 3pm this Sunday at Churchill Park in Lautoka.

item.title: Captain Lomani ready for physical test against South Africa
item.description: Vodafone Fijiana XV captain Kolora Lomani says it is an absolute honour to lead the national side, adding that she never imagined she would captain the team during her rugby career. Lomani made the comments as the Fijiana XV continue preparations for their match against the South African Women's Team this Saturday.
item.content:encoded:
Vodafone Fijiana XV captain Kolora Lomani says it is an absolute honour to lead the national side, adding that she never imagined she would captain the team during her rugby career.

Lomani made the comments as the Fijiana XV continue preparations for their match against the South African Women's Team this Saturday.

She says it is a privilege to captain the side this week and believes having experienced leaders such as prop Bitila Tawake and lock Alfreda Fisher alongside her is a major boost for the team.

Lomani adds that the Fijiana XV are expecting a physical contest against the Springbok Women this weekend and are working hard to ensure they are ready for the challenge.

The Fijiana team will face the South African team at 2pm at the HFC Bank Stadium in Suva.
